description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting The Great Henge and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting The Great Henge and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping The Great Henge and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
